features.name: spiral ice platform track
features.notes: Sequential platforms wrap upward around the mountain from base to peak, with platforms stacked above one another.
features.quote: A spiralling chain of ice platforms wrapping the mountain

features.name: wide snowy base platform
features.notes: At the bottom of the mountain; wide enough for multiple players.

features.name: lower climbing platforms
features.notes: Lower band of the upward ascent.

features.name: middle climbing platforms
features.notes: Middle band of the upward ascent.

features.name: frozen cliff walls
features.notes: Form the mountain sides between platform sections.

features.name: thin ice bridges
features.notes: Narrow bridges connecting separated sections of the ascent.

features.name: glowing ice crystal clusters
features.notes: Cyan crystal formations growing from platforms and cliff walls.
features.quote: Clusters of glowing cyan ice crystal formations growing off the platforms and the frozen cliff walls.

features.name: summit safe platform
features.notes: Wide, flat top platform at the peak, roomy enough for several players.
features.quote: a wide safe platform at the very top

features.name: neon accented summit ice
features.notes: Neon-accented ice rings the summit platform.

features.name: lava floor
features.notes: Visible underneath and around the ice mountain, outside the ice platforms.
features.quote: The lava floor under the mountain

features.name: icy blue cyan palette
features.notes: Icy blue, white, and cyan colors with neon accents.
features.quote: Use icy blue, white, and cyan colors with some neon accents.

features.name: tall ice mountain
features.notes: About 100 studs high, rising from a broad base to a narrow peak.
